'''Lingadahalli Subrahmanya Shashidhara''' (born 1963) is an Indian developmental biologist, geneticist and a professor of biology currently serving as the Centre Director of National Centre for Biological Sciences, Bengaluru, India. He was a Professor at the [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune]], and at [[Ashoka University]], Sonepat, India. He heads the LSS Laboratory at IISER<ref name="LSS Lab - Home">{{cite web | url=http://www.iiserpune.ac.in/~ls.shashidhara/ | title=LSS Lab Home | publisher=LSS Lab – IISER |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> and is known for his studies on [[Drosophila]], particularly the evolution of appendages and functions of [[homeotic selector gene]]s.<ref name="L S Shashidhara - Biography">{{cite web | url=http://www.sandhyasekar.com/conf/speaker/l-s-shashidhara/ | title=L S Shashidhara – Biography | work=2016 | publisher=IISER Thiruvananthapuram | access-date=26 October 2016 }}{{Dead link|date=February 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> He is a J. C. Bose National Fellow of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]] and an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]],<ref name="Indian fellow - Shashidhara">{{cite web | url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P07-1446 | title=Indian fellow – Shashidhara | publisher=Indian National Science Academy |year=2016 | access-date=25 October 2016}}</ref> [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="Fellow Profile - Shashidhara">{{cite web | url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Shashidhara,_Prof._Lingadahalli_Subrahmanya | title=Fellow Profile – Shashidhara | publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |year=2016 | access-date=25 October 2016}}</ref> and the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]].<ref name="NASI fellows">{{cite web | url=http://nasi.nic.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=S | title=NASI fellows | publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2008, for his contributions to biological sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |year=2016 | access-date=5 October 2016}}</ref>

In 2018, L.S. Shashidhara was elected an Associate Member of [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO), making him the third scientist from India to join a group of about 1800 researchers.

L. S. Shashidhara was elected as the president of the [http://www.iubs.org/ International Union of Biological Sciences (IUBS)] in the 33rd General Assembly of IUBS held during the [https://www.iubs100years.org/33rd-ga/new-executive-committee Centenary Year Event of IUBS], at Oslo, in 2019. On behalf of IUBS, Shashidhara is steering an international project on [https://tropicsu.org/ Climate Change Education (titled as TROP ICSU)]. This project is supported by many unions and UN organizations.

== Biography ==
L. S. Shashidhara, born on 23 March 1963 in the south Indian state of Karnataka, graduated in science from [[University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad]] (UAS) in 1985 and obtained a master's degree in Genetics and Plant breeding in 1987 from the same university.<ref name="Brief Biodata">{{cite web | url=http://www.ccmb.res.in/staff/shashi/publication.html | title=Brief Biodata | publisher=Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> After a brief stint (1987–88) at UAS as a teaching associate, he moved to [[University of Cambridge]] in 1988 for his doctoral studies to secure a PhD in 1991. On completion of his post-doctoral studies at Cambridge (1991–93), he returned to India to join [[National Centre for Biological Sciences]] and worked as a visiting fellow for two years. Subsequently, he moved to [[Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology]] (CCMB) in 1995 as a scientist (group leader)<ref name="Drosophila Genetics & Developmental Biology">{{cite web | url=http://www.ccmb.res.in/staff/shashi/droso.html | title=Drosophila Genetics & Developmental Biology | publisher=CCMB |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> where he served until 2007 when he was transferred, on deputation, to the [[Pune]] centre of [[Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research]] (IISER) as a professor.<ref name="Prof. LS Shashidhara - LSS Lab">{{cite web | url=http://www.iiserpune.ac.in/~ls.shashidhara/lab-members/prof-ls-shashidhara-2.html | title=Prof. LS Shashidhara – LSS Lab | publisher=IISER, PUne |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> Since then, he has been serving the institute as a professor and has served as the chair of Biology and the coordinator of the department of biology.<ref name="Coordinator - Department of Biology">{{cite web | url=https://openi.nlm.nih.gov/detailedresult.php?img=PMC2646550_JCB_200812123_Fig13&req=4 | title=Coordinator – Department of Biology | publisher=Open Access Biomedical Image Search Engine |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> He pursues his research interests as the head of the LSS Laboratory at IISER, where he hosts a number doctoral and postdoctoral scholars.<ref name="LSS Lab - Home" /> He also serves as an honorary professor at [[Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research]].<ref name="Prof. LS Shashidhara - LSS Lab" /> He served as the vice-president of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] from 2015 to 2017 and secretary general of the International Union of Biological Sciences from 2015-2019.

== Career ==
[[File:Drosophila melanogaster - side (aka).jpg|thumb|235px|Drosophila melanogaster]]
Shashidhara's research was focused on [[developmental biology]], specifically the development of limbs and the role played by [[Ultrabithorax]], a [[Hox gene]], functioning as a [[transcription factor]].<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{cite web | url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | year=1999 | access-date=5 October 2016 | page=34 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | archive-date=4 March 2016 }}</ref> Studying [[Drosophila melanogaster]] (commonly known as fruit fly) as a model, he elucidated the molecular pathways [[Wnt signaling pathway|Wnt]], [[TGF beta signaling pathway|TGF]]-? and [[Epidermal growth factor receptor|EGFR]]/Ras that impact growth control and developed a ''fly model'' for studying [[Adenomatous polyposis coli]], the [[colon cancer]] gene in humans. His studies are reported to have assisted in a wider understanding of the relation between genes and diseases in humans and in the development of cancer drug discovery systems.<ref name="Indian fellow - Shashidhara" /> His research findings have been published in a number of articles{{Refn|group=note|25 of his articles are reported to be high-impact articles<ref name="Indian fellow - Shashidhara" />}} published in peer-reviewed journals,<ref name="Publication by Fellows">{{cite web | url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Shashidhara=3ALingadahalli_Subrahmanya=3A=3A.html | title=Publication by Fellows | work=Article listing | publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> several of them have been listed in online article repositories such as [[Metascience (journal)|Metascience]],<ref name="Lingadahalli Subrahmanya Shashidhara on Metascience">{{cite web | url=https://meta.science/author/102377886_lingadahalli_subrahmanya_shashidhara | title=Lingadahalli Subrahmanya Shashidhara on Metascience | publisher=Metascience | year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016 | archive-date=1 November 2016 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161101164757/https://meta.science/author/102377886_lingadahalli_subrahmanya_shashidhara }}</ref> [[PubMed]],<ref name="Shashidhara on PubMed">{{PubMedAuthorSearch|Shashidhara|LS}}</ref> and [[ResearchGate]].<ref name="Lingadahalli S Shashidhara on ResearchGate">{{cite web | url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Lingadahalli_Shashidhara/publications | title=Lingadahalli S Shashidhara on ResearchGate |year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> He has also published many general articles and has delivered keynote addresses and featured talks.<ref name="Behavioural Adaptations and Evolution">{{cite web | url=http://cscs.res.in/events_folder/talks-and-work-in-progress/cscsevent.2010-02-25.1865742899 | title=Behavioural Adaptations and Evolution | work=Featured talk | publisher=Centre for the Study of Culture and Society | date=11 March 2010 | access-date=26 October 2016 | author=L. S. Shashidhara}}</ref><ref name="Cell Biology of Organ Development in Drosophila">{{cite web | url=http://www.sandhyasekar.com/conf/session/l-s-shashidhara/ | title=Cell Biology of Organ Development in Drosophila | publisher=IISER | date=7 December 2015 | access-date=26 October 2016 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161104071245/http://www.sandhyasekar.com/conf/session/l-s-shashidhara/ | archive-date=4 November 2016 }}</ref> He served as the secretary-general of the [[International Union of Biological Sciences]] (IUBS),<ref name="IUBS Officers and Executive Committee Members">{{cite web | url=https://www.iubs.org/iubs/currentboard.html | title=IUBS Officers and Executive Committee Members | publisher=International Union of Biological Sciences | year=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016 }}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> during 2015–2019 and is associated with the ''[[Journal of Genetics]]'' and ''[[Current Science]]'' as their associate editor and with ''[[Scientific Reports]]'' as a member of its editorial board.<ref name="Prof. LS Shashidhara - LSS Lab" />

== Awards and honours ==
Shashidhara, a [[Jagadish Chandra Bose|J. C. Bose]] National Fellow of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]], received the Technology Prize in Biological Sciences of the [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] in 2003<ref name="Prof. LS Shashidhara elected Vice President of the Indian National Science Academy">{{cite web |date=13 January 2016 |title=Prof. LS Shashidhara elected Vice President of the Indian National Science Academy |url=http://www.iiserpune.ac.in/news/prof-ls-shashidhara-elected-vice-president-of-the-indian-national-science-academy |access-date=26 October 2016 |publisher=IISER Pune News}}</ref> and the Outstanding Research Investigator Award of the Science Research Council of the [[Department of Atomic Energy]] in 2006.<ref name="Prof. LS Shashidhara - LSS Lab" /> The Indian academy of Sciences elected him as a fellow in 2007 and he became an elected fellow of the Indian National Science Academy<ref name="Indian fellow - Shashidhara" /> and the National Academy of Sciences, India in 2008. The same year he received the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]] of the [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to Biological Sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees" /> In 2018, L.S. Shashidhara has been elected an Associate Member of [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO). He is currently elected as the president of [http://www.iubs.org/ International Union Of Biological Sciences.]
